00067 void LagUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00068 {
00069     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00070     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00071     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00072     float* lagSamples = inputs[LagTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00073     float newLagTime = *lagSamples;
00074     
00075     ugen_assert(newLagTime >= 0.f);
00076     
00077     if(newLagTime != currentLagTime)
00078     {
00079         float next_b1 = newLagTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 / (newLagTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00080         float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor();
00081         currentLagTime = newLagTime;
00082         
00083         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00084         {
00085             b1 += b1_slope;
00086             float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00087             *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1 * (y1 - y0));
00088         }
00089         
00090         b1 = next_b1;
00091     }
00092     else
00093     {
00094         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00095         {
00096             float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00097             *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1 * (y1 - y0));
00098         }
00099     }
00100     
00101     y1 = zap(y1); // denormal!
00102 }

00119     float newLagTime = *lagSamples;

00123     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;

00126     {
00127         float next_b1 = newLagTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 * krBlockSize / (newLagTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00128         float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor() * krBlockSize;
00129         currentLagTime = newLagTime; 
00130                 
00131         while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00132         {
00133             float nextValue = value;

00137                 float y0 = *inputSamples;

00153                 }

00263 void LagUDUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00264 {
00265     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00266     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00267     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00268     float* lagUpSamples = inputs[LagTimeUp].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00269     float* lagDownSamples = inputs[LagTimeDown].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00270     float newLagTimeUp = *lagUpSamples;
00271     float newLagTimeDown = *lagDownSamples;
00272     
00273     ugen_assert(newLagTimeUp >= 0.f);
00274     ugen_assert(newLagTimeDown >= 0.f);
00275     
00276     if((newLagTimeUp != currentLagTimeUp) || (newLagTimeDown != currentLagTimeDown))
00277     {
00278         float next_b1u = newLagTimeUp == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 / (newLagTimeUp * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00279         float next_b1d = newLagTimeDown == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 / (newLagTimeDown * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00280         float b1u_slope = (next_b1u - b1u) * UGen::getSlopeFactor();
00281         float b1d_slope = (next_b1d - b1d) * UGen::getSlopeFactor();
00282         currentLagTimeUp = newLagTimeUp;
00283         currentLagTimeDown = newLagTimeDown;
00284         
00285         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00286         {
00287             b1u += b1u_slope;
00288             b1d += b1d_slope;
00289             float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00290             
00291             if (y0 > y1)
00292                 *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1u * (y1 - y0));
00293             else
00294                 *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1d * (y1 - y0));
00295         }
00296         
00297         b1u = next_b1u;
00298         b1d = next_b1d;
00299     }
00300     else

00302         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00303         {
00304             float y0 = *inputSamples++;

00306                 *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1u * (y1 - y0));
00307             else
